title: Temp liaison effort - Sparrow micro-tally (2026-02-18)
body:
Purpose and context:
This is a lightweight, ad-hoc tally intended to surface short-lived liaison effort across three orgs while we run the Sparrow pilot (small experimental integration between Hosted API routing + Dedicated fallbacks). Not a replacement for full capacity planning; use for quick handoffs and daily stand checks while pilot runs (2–6 weeks).

How to use:
- Owner maintains row for each person currently acting as a liaison or temporary coverage owner.
- Update est. hrs/week and blockers daily if changed.
- If coverage gap appears, flag in slack channel and tag product-ops.

CSV-style tracker (columns): Liaison, Team, Primary-tasks, Est-hrs-week, Current-blockers, Coverage-window, Notes

Rows:
Lina Chen, product-ops, intake + daily handoff to SRE & SEs, 8, unclear handoff for regional failover (see OPS-8451), 2026-02-18 -> 2026-03-10, primary point for canary schedule
Drew Kaplan, eng-observability, telemetry + alert tuning, 6, missing trace tags for fallback path, 2026-02-22 -> 2026-03-05, will push minor schema change PR by 2026-02-24
Asha Patel, solutions-eng, customer liaison for pilot customers, 10, two customers need additional audit logs, 2026-02-18 -> 2026-03-12, coordinating with security for log retention
Miguel Ortega, dedicated-ops, capacity headroom validation, 12, burst policy thresholds unclear across regions, 2026-02-19 -> 2026-03-02, running nightly capacity smoke tests
Rahul Singh, sre, oncall coverage & runbook edits, 5, runbook lacks rollback steps for model-version fallback, 2026-02-20 -> 2026-03-04, drafting rollback snippet
Emma Rosales, support, triage + customer notes, 6, need a templated customer message for degraded latency, 2026-02-20 -> 2026-03-01, will prepare template and ship to support playbook
Kai Okafor, infra, network policy coordination, 4, VPC peering window conflicts with maintenance, 2026-02-23 -> 2026-03-02, requested maintenance shift to evening PST
Juno Park, console-ux, small runbook UI polish for liaison view, 3, awaiting telemetry field names, 2026-02-24 -> 2026-03-05, planning 1-day hotfix

Quick tallies (as of last update):
- Total estimated liaison-hours/week: 54
- Active blockers flagged: 5 (priorities: OPS-8451, CON-292, SE-701)
- Regions impacted: us-west-2 (primary), eu-west-1 (secondary)

Immediate actions (owner notes):
- Lina: escalate OPS-8451 with SRE lead; ask for explicit handoff line in runbook by EOD 2026-02-19.
- Drew: push trace tag PR and ping Juno for UI mapping (due 2026-02-24).
- Miguel: share capacity smoke test artifacts (s3://redwood-pilot/sparrow-tests) and results by 2026-02-21.
- Asha: assemble audit-log ask template and open compliance sync (linked artifacts).

Open questions / decision log:
- Q1: Which fallback burn-rate threshold should trigger immediate deprovisioning vs. scaled fallback? (Decision owner: infra; tentative: 60% sustained burst for 10m)
- Q2: Do we route pilot customers to Dedicated fallback automatically, or require manual opt-in? (Product ops leaning: auto with customer opt-out)
- Decision notes: product-ops to surface to leadership during weekly pilot check-in (Wed 10:00).

Notes-to-self / quick scratch items:
- If a liaison is unavailable, mark their row with an explicit deputy and escalate in slack.
- Consider converting to a full sheet with date columns if we keep pilot beyond 3 weeks.
- Keep this doc lightweight and remove stale rows weekly.

Recent changes (timeline):
- 2026-02-18: initial creation with core liaisons (Lina)
- 2026-02-19: added Miguel, Rahul after infra smoke test
- 2026-02-22: updated Drew blocker after finding missing trace tags

Contact / handoff
- Primary owner: Lina Chen (lina@redwood.ai) - ping in slack @lina for immediate updates
- Secondary contact: Drew Kaplan (drew@redwood.ai)

Notes about artifacts and further reading:
- See Confluence:SPARROW-bridge-notes-2026 for design context and rollout decisions.
- Ticket OPS-8451 contains runbook and handoff details.

End of tracker (keep at top of shared_drives/company/misc while pilot active).
